title: Detroit Charter Company

services.name: Hydra - Brunch Sail
services.desc: Detroit Fireworks Sail is a public experience built around one of the city’s most anticipated nights on the water. Guests are welcomed aboard HYDRA and settle in as the vessel departs ahead of the event. The experience is structured around positioning and timing. The vessel moves into a designated viewing area and remains in place to provide a clear and uninterrupted perspective of the display. Guests are free to move throughout the yacht as the event approaches and unfolds. - On-water viewing of Detroit fireworks events - Elevated vantage point aboard HYDRA - Controlled positioning for clear sightlines - Evening sailing environment - Limited-capacity public experience Detroit Fireworks

services.name: Race Charters
services.desc: The Managed Race Charter is a private program designed to provide teams with a complete and structured racing platform aboard TRIDENT. This is a race participation charter with full campaign support, not a single-event booking. The program is built around planning, preparation, and execution across one or multiple events. Detroit Charter Company manages the operational aspects of the campaign, allowing the team to focus on performance, coordination, and race objectives. - Fully managed race program aboard TRIDENT - Structured support across multiple events - Campaign planning, preparation, and execution - Dedicated platform for team performance - Turnkey approach to offshore and regatta

services.name: Sentinel - Eco Tour
services.desc: Eco Tour is a private charter designed to explore the natural side of Detroit’s waterways. Guests board SENTINEL and move through areas that provide access to shoreline habitat, open water, and quieter sections of the river. The experience is paced for observation. Movement is steady but unhurried, allowing time to take in the surroundings, ask questions, and engage with the environment. The structure supports both guided conversation and quiet time on the water. - RIB-based access to shallow and shoreline environments - Focus on local ecology and waterway systems - Quiet, observation-driven pacing - Small group format - Flexible routing based on conditions Eco Tour provides access to parts
